explanation: Meta Labeling - This model acts as a secondary filter. It observes a base strategy and predicts whether the base strategy's next trade will be a win or a loss. It operates with signal parameters such as base_model_family=bayesian_markov, meta_threshold=0.55, feature_window_set=[10, 20, 50]. To control risk, it halts trading after 1 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 2 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 4 units. It dynamically stops trading after excessive continuous market streaks to avoid severe drawdowns.
